description: This source file defines a React functional component named EditUserModal, which provides a modal dialog for editing user details. It includes form fields for user email, role, spend, budget, and reset options, leveraging UI libraries like '@tremor/react' and 'antd'. It also handles form state, submission, and resets upon cancellations or updates.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Handles modal cancellation by resetting the form and calling the onCancel callback.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls the onSubmit callback with form values, resets the form, and cancels the modal.
